findings.issue: The v3-upgrade test checks the default settings only through readSettings(), which also returns DEFAULT_SETTINGS when no record exists. An upgrade step that created the store but put the record only on a fresh database (e.g. guarded by oldVersion === 0) would still pass, although the test name says the upgrade 'adds default settings'.
findings.evidence: Line 117: expect(await store.readSettings()).toEqual(DEFAULTS); the withDb block reads hands/sessions/reports but not SETTINGS_STORE. readSettings: value === undefined ? DEFAULT_SETTINGS : parseSettings(value).
findings.fix: In the withDb block also read transaction(SETTINGS_STORE).get(SETTINGS_KEY) and expect it toEqual(DEFAULTS) (add SETTINGS_STORE to the transaction scope).

findings.issue: Because the quote is optional, role={dialog} (a variable named dialog) is counted as a dialog, and role={open ? 'dialog' : undefined} is missed. Neither form exists in src/ui today; the false positive would show up as a loud 'dialog X is not in the screen list' failure, not a silent miss. The doc says 'with any quote', which slightly undersells what matches.
findings.evidence: /<dialog\b|role=\{?\s*["'`]?(alert)?dialog\b/ matches 'role={dialog}'. Spec D-6 gives this exact regex, so it matches the spec.
findings.fix: None needed now. If it ever matters, require a quote after '{': role=(?:\{\s*)?["'`](alert)?dialog["'`]|role=(alert)?dialog\b.

findings.issue: The bullet's inline code continues onto an unindented line, so the third test path renders outside the code span and outside the list item.
findings.fix: Indent the continuation line by two spaces, or put the command on one line.

findings.issue: .settings-section repeats .panel's background/border/radius/padding. That's justified because .panel's flex: 1 1 420px would make sections 420px tall in the column-flex .screen, but a short comment would explain why it isn't simply className="panel".
findings.evidence: .panel { flex: 1 1 420px; background: #1a1d22; border: 1px solid #343a43; border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; }
findings.fix: Optional: add a short comment, or leave it as is.

summary: All 17 SPEC items are implemented as written, and the tests would catch a broken implementation. (1) The v4 upgrade only adds: a new oldVersion < 4 step creates the settings store and puts a copy of DEFAULT_SETTINGS. The v3-upgrade unit test seeds one record each in hands, sessions and reports and checks them unchanged, plus the version and the store names. The step in all three e2e helpers (hands, sessions, readStore) matches the app's exactly: out-of-line keys, key 'settings', the same five values. The copies are needed because page.evaluate functions must be self-contained. (2) readSettings returns the frozen DEFAULT_SETTINGS when there is no record, and parseSettings otherwise. parseSettings rejects null, arrays and non-objects as 'settings', names the first bad field in spec order, and drops extra fields. The tests cover every listed row plus a multi-field case. (3) The version comes from Vite define in vite.config.ts, which covers build, dev and Vitest (there is no separate vitest config). SPEC-04 checks APP_VERSION === package.json version in Vitest, and the e2e checks it in the built app. No tools entry imports App or app-version, so the node-based playtest scripts are unaffected. (4) Locked edits only re-pin values and keep every check: home.spec count 2->3 plus a Settings-visible check; resume.spec count 2->3 and 3->4, .last() moved to Settings and Statistics still pinned with nth(); screen-list routes gain 'settings'; play-money walk adds a Settings step; session-end DB_VERSION 3->4 and store names; home-control store names. (5) The DIALOG regex is exactly D-6. It accepts string and JSX-expression roles in any quote style, and rejects role={'dialogue-panel'} through \b. The only false positive is a bare identifier role={dialog} (NIT). (6) Settings is last in the menu, gets the same setPaused(undefined) as New game, and returns with returned: true so Home's h1 is focused. The e2e checks focus on both headings. (7) Over budget at 31 files vs 25, but every extra file is needed or trivial: tests/ui/play-money.test.ts (its fixture is checked against the real SCREEN_LIST, so adding settings would break it), tests/storage/hand-store.test.ts (DB_VERSION pin), the two Block-1 locked tests, and two one-line stale-version fixes in docs/storage/sessions.md and reports.md. Lines (834) are within budget. All 9 changed Vitest files pass locally (24 tests). Only one MINOR finding (raw default record not checked after the v3 upgrade) and three NITs. No BLOCKER or MAJOR.
